mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM sys_role r, sys_user_role sur WHERE r.id = sur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND sur.del_flag = '0' and sur.user_id IN (#{userId})
SELECT sur.user_id AS "userId", r.id AS "roleId" FROM sys_role r, sys_user_role sur WHERE r.id = sur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND sur.del_flag = '0' AND sur.user_id IN #{uid}

SELECT sur.user_id AS "userId", r.id AS "roleId", r.role_name AS "roleName", r.role_code AS "roleCode", r.role_desc AS "roleDesc" FROM sys_role r, sys_user_role sur WHERE r.id = sur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND sur.del_flag = '0' AND sur.user_id IN #{uid}
